name: Limits rest on evidence
ownerWords: i want daily duty to hunt for these and ferociously remove them aggressively
goal: No limit in auto-sns-agent rests on a guess. Every cap, ceiling, budget, throttle, timeout, backoff, retry count, batch size and concurrency setting cites a measurement, a vendor doc or an incident in the ledger, or it is gone with the code that served it. Each run removes every unbacked limit it finds.

metrics.label: Limit candidates with no verdict in the ledger
Unbacked limits found but still in the code

onMiss: Follow the playbook limits-evidence.md next to this precheck, in sieun-pi components/user-history/scripts/duties/. The ledger is apps/llm-wiki/content/domains/devops/limits-ledger.json in auto-sns-agent: read it first, write it last. The precheck output file holds every candidate, new ones first. Start one subagent per app with unjudged, new or unbacked candidates. A limit stays only with evidence: a measurement in the wiki or code, a vendor doc link, or an incident it prevents. Without evidence the subagent deletes it and the code that only served it. A limit on money, an outside send or account ban risk with no evidence is the owner's call, never removed. Each app ships one stack of commit objects built in a private GIT_INDEX_FILE on local sieun/dev, one commit per limit, "chore(<app>): drop unbacked limit <name>". Send each stack to this chat for Fable's probe slot and a fresh ci/ ref, never a force push. Send this chat the found, removed and kept counts as chat_board ops.
